name: lightcone
description: Work on an ASTRA analysis with the lightcone-cli (lc) toolchain: scaffold and scope new analyses from a research question, bring an existing codebase into ASTRA, run/verify/diagnose the lc workflow, and file feedback. Ships SessionStart/PostToolUse hooks that activate the project venv and validate astra.yaml on save. Use for any interactive work inside an lc / ASTRA project, including ingesting an existing project. The `new` skill bundles the full lc CLI reference (references/cli.md).
